subject: Partner Concierge: Launch cadence & concierge enablement plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Adrian Cole <adrian@stratusconsulting.com>, Maya Chen <maya@convergesys.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 15:08:00 -0000
Subject: Partner Concierge: Launch cadence & concierge enablement plan

Hi Adrian / Maya,

Thanks for the kickoff call this morning — great to see alignment on the early SI use cases. Per our discussion I sketched a concise "concierge" launch cadence to get two initial PoC customers live in 6 weeks. High-level proposal below; attaching a short playbook + lab steps for reference.

Proposed 6-week cadence (concierge model):
- Week 0 (Prep): provisioning + entitlement & T1 kickoff call (1hr) with SI, Redwood AM, and Eng concierge
- Week 1-2 (Enablement): 3x 90-min live enablement sessions (architecture, runtime tuning, evaluation) + hands-on labs
- Week 3-4 (Co-delivery): joint SI/Redwood runbooks, 2 concierge office hours/week for customer onboarding
- Week 5 (Hardening): latency/cost tuning pass, rollout plan for dedicated capacity if needed
- Week 6 (Handoff): success metrics review, playbook handoff, and enablement certification for SI engineers

Success metrics (mutually agreed):
- Two PoCs functional (end-to-end inference) by week 6
- <200ms median 2k-token tail latency on test harness for PoC workload OR documented fallback plan
- Inference cost per 1k tokens reduced by 20% vs baseline through batching/cache configuration

Immediate asks for Stratus to unblock scheduling:
1) List of 4 SI engineers who will attend enablement sessions with emails + timezones
2) Access to a representative inference prompt set and one sample dataset (S3 or Drive link)
3) Preferred weekly windows for concierge office hours (PST windows preferred)

Attachments: Redwood_Partner_Concierge_Playbook_v1.pdf (attachment), Concierge_Labs_Onboarding_Steps.xlsx (attachment)

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once I have the attendee list.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Partner Programs Lead | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 09:17:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Partner Concierge: Launch cadence & concierge enablement plan

Sean,

This looks good — appreciate the structure. Quick responses inline:

- SI attendee list: attaching a short roster. Primary leads: Maya Chen (maya@convergesys.co), Victor Ramos (victor.r@stratusconsulting.com), and Lina Park (lina.p@stratusconsulting.com).
- We'll share a sanitized prompt set and a 5GB S3 bucket with sample utterances by EOD today.
- Office hours: Tue/Thu 10:00-12:00 PST works for our east/west teams.

Two notes / asks from us:
1) Can Redwood provide a pre-configured test harness (load script + scoring) so we can validate latency/cost numbers consistently?
2) We want a short enablement certificate for SI engineers so they can list Redwood Concierge on their service page — any template you suggest?

I've attached the SI_roster.csv and I'll expect the S3 link shortly. Looking forward to the calendar invite.

Cheers,
Adrian Cole
Director, Strategic Integrations
Stratus Consulting
attachments: SI_roster.csv (attachment)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Adrian Cole <adrian@stratusconsulting.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 16:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Partner Concierge: Launch cadence & concierge enablement plan

Adrian — great, roster received. Answers below: 

1) Test harness: yes — attached is a lightweight harness (python + load script) and we will provide a hosted runner for the first PoC so you don't need infra. It will include token-level tracing and cost breakdowns. We'll also share the metrics dashboard link once the runner is live.

2) Enablement certificate: Laura (cc) has a one-page template for partner certification; Laura, can you drop the template and outline the criteria? My proposal: attend the three live sessions, complete the labs, and pass a short verification run with the harness.

Next steps I will take today:
- Send calendar invites for the three enablement sessions (we'll record and upload to the partner drive)
- Spin up hosted runner for PoC #1 and share access by Friday
- Upload the tracking sheet for success metrics and playbook edits to the Drive link below

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bConciergePlaybook
Playbook attachment referenced in prior email: Redwood_Partner_Concierge_Playbook_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Sean

Adrian / Sean,

Attaching the partner certification template and the verification checklist. Summary here so everyone has the criteria: 
- Attend three live enablement sessions (required)
- Complete two hands-on labs end-to-end (lab artifacts submitted)
- Achieve pass on verification run (pre-configured harness) with documented baseline metrics

If an SI completes the criteria, we issue a "Redwood Concierge Ally" badge and a short profile blurb they can use on their site. Adrian — once Victor/Lina/Maya complete the verification run, reply-all with the artifacts and we'll issue the certificates within 3 business days.

Attachments: Redwood_Concierge_Cert_Template.docx (attachment), Verification_Checklist.pdf (attachment)
